text:
mira: Starting a concise playbook thread for model-catalog lifecycle: onboarding -> pinning -> deprecations -> migrations. Need decisions we can hand to Sales/Legal/SRE.
jamal: We should keep the policy modular. High-level ask: what's GA-safe default vs negotiable contract terms?
sophie: GA-safe defaults: shadow -> 3% canary -> 25% ramp -> 100% with automated rollback. Negotiable items: pin duration, extra canary steps, dedicated monitoring windows.
evan: Operational constraints: include KV cache compatibility check in shadow and a cache-flush hook in the rollout. Also require a lightweight token-recon job post-rollout.
mira: Draft default pin policy suggestion: soft-pin = 30 days (auto-notify 7d before expiry), customers can request one 30d extension. Hard-pin requires SOW + legal review.
jamal: Sales levers: offer 60/90 day soft-pins or 1yr hard-pins as paid add-ons. Track as checkbox in SOW template.
sophie: Deprecation runway: default 60 days public notice, with personal outreach to pinned customers and a 30-day migration window. Emergency deprecations: Exec + Legal + Security sign-off.
evan: Migration lanes: shadow -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Each step: run monitors for 30-120m based on impact; automatic rollback if any alert fires.
mira: Monitors to gate progression: p95 latency delta, error rate, cost per token delta, and eval-set pass-rate. Keep thresholds conservative for first GA families.
jamal: Propose concrete thresholds to start discussion: p95 latency +20% (absolute), error rate increase >0.5% over baseline, cost increase >30%, eval pass-rate drop >2% relative. These are negotiable.
sophie: For eval pass-rate we need canonical probes per workload (chat/search/summarize) and tenant probes for high-value customers. Who maintains them? Solutions owns tenant probes; Product owns canonical sets. We'll add ownership mapping in playbook.
evan: Rollback ergonomics for SREs: include quick CLI stubs and a playbook snippet with steps to pause traffic, route to fallback model, and run billing reconcile. Example:
```
# quick revert flow
redwoodctl rollout revert --model catalog:aurora:v5 --to catalog:aurora:v4 --reason "canary-breach"
redwoodctl traffic route --to catalog:aurora:v4 --scope rollout_id
redwoodctl billing pause --scope rollout_id
```
legal-bot: policy-check: any pin that overrides default retention or telemetry must run through Data Protection review. Note requirements for EU and HIPAA customers.
mira: Add billing safety: pause token billing for affected tenants during rollback window and record provisional credits. Reconcile postmortem to finalize charges.
jamal: Migration credits: sliding scale tied to eval regression bands. Example: 1-2% drop -> 2% credit; 2-4% -> 5% credit + remediation; >4% -> higher credit + dedicated eng support. Add to SOW as fallback.
sophie: UX: Console needs per-tenant pin toggle, a visible deprecation banner with countdown, and an easy request-pin flow that creates a ticket for Sales/Legal.
evan: Infra: feature-flag gating for canary steps + automated rollback if monitors exceed thresholds. Also need test harness to run a compatibility smoke before scheduling ramp.
mira: Communications: PRE (72h for non-critical changes), LAUNCH (status channel + in-console banner + telemetry dashboard), POST (summary + credits/mitigation note). Provide email and in-console templates in the playbook.
jamal: Exceptions rubric for pin denials: risk to platform stability + compliance conflict + contract mismatch. Legal sign-off required if > threshold.
sophie: Postmortems: mandatory when rollback occurs. Template fields: timeline, trigger, metrics, customer impact, billing adjustments, follow-ups.
evan: Small-model families variant: lightweight flow (shadow -> 10% -> 100% if no alerts in 1h). Need explicit "structural change" gate (vocab/size changes) to force full onboarding.
mira: Action items: sophie -> canonical probe ownership doc + comm templates by Thu; evan -> rollout CLI snippets + feature-flag plan by Wed; jamal -> SOW pin clauses + credit bands by Fri. I'll compile final playbook draft and loop Legal.
legal-bot: reminder: any deviation from default pin TTL needs a signed amendment.
mira: Let's reconvene next Mon for final sign-off. Drop comments here if you see edge cases. :seedling:
